indicators.name: Taxa de utilização global de consultas médicas
indicators.description: Proportion of enrolled patients who had at least one medical consultation (in-person or remote) during the analysis period.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care access - tracks overall consultation utilization rates across health units.

indicators.name: Proporção de consultas realizadas pelo Enfermeiro de Família
indicators.description: Proportion of nursing consultations each family nurse provides to their assigned patients versus total consultations by all nurses.
indicators.pets_relevance: Family doctors/nurses - measures how effectively family nursing assignments are being used in primary care.

indicators.name: Taxa de utilização de consultas médicas - 3 anos
indicators.description: Proportion of registered patients who had at least one medical consultation (in-person or remote) within the last 3 years.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care access - long-term utilization metric identifying patients potentially disconnected from the health system.

indicators.name: Proporção de utilizadores referenciados para consulta hospitalar
indicators.description: Proportion of users referred for hospital consultation during the analysis period.
indicators.pets_relevance: Consultations/waiting lists - tracks referral volume from primary care to hospital consultations.

indicators.name: Taxa de utilização de consultas de Planeamento Familiar (méd./enf.)
indicators.description: Proportion of women of reproductive age who had at least one family planning consultation (medical or nursing) in the last 12 months.
indicators.pets_relevance: Consultations - reproductive health access in primary care, relevant to births monitoring.

indicators.name: Taxa de utilização de consultas de Planeamento Familiar (enf.)
indicators.description: Proportion of women of childbearing age who had at least one family planning nursing consultation in the previous 12 months.
indicators.pets_relevance: Consultations - nursing-specific family planning access, relevant to births and reproductive health monitoring.

indicators.name: Taxa de utilização de consultas de Planeamento Familiar (méd.)
indicators.description: Proportion of women of childbearing age who had at least one family planning medical consultation in the previous 12 months.
indicators.pets_relevance: Consultations - medical family planning access, relevant to births and reproductive health monitoring.

indicators.name: Proporção de grávidas com 1ª consulta médica de vigilância da gravidez no 1º trimestre
indicators.description: Proportion of pregnant women who completed their first medical prenatal consultation during the first trimester.
indicators.pets_relevance: Births/screenings - early prenatal care access is a key perinatal health quality indicator.

indicators.name: Proporção de grávidas com 6+ consultas de enfermagem em saúde materna
indicators.description: Proportion of postpartum women who completed at least 6 nursing consultations for pregnancy and postpartum surveillance.
indicators.pets_relevance: Births/consultations - tracks adequacy of maternal nursing surveillance during pregnancy and postpartum.

indicators.name: Proporção de puérperas com domicílio de enfermagem
indicators.description: Percentage of postpartum women who received at least one nursing home visit during the 42-day postpartum period.
indicators.pets_relevance: Births - postpartum home nursing visit coverage, a key indicator for maternal and neonatal care quality.

indicators.name: Proporção de recém-nascidos com consulta médica até aos 28 dias de vida
indicators.description: Proportion of newborns who complete their first medical check-up within 28 days of birth.
indicators.pets_relevance: Births/screenings - neonatal health surveillance, critical for early detection of health issues in newborns.

indicators.name: Proporção de recém-nascidos com domicílio de enfermagem até 15º dia de vida
indicators.description: Proportion of newborns who received at least one nursing home visit during their first 15 days of life.
indicators.pets_relevance: Births - early neonatal nursing home visits, important for monitoring newborn health and supporting families.

indicators.name: Proporção de crianças com 6+ consultas médicas de vigilância no 1º ano de vida
indicators.description: Proportion of children who completed at least 6 medical surveillance consultations during their first year of life.
indicators.pets_relevance: Consultations/screenings - child health surveillance in primary care, tracks pediatric preventive care coverage.

indicators.name: Proporção de crianças com 3+ consultas médicas de vigilância no 2º ano de vida
indicators.description: Proportion of children who completed at least 3 medical surveillance consultations during their second year of life.
indicators.pets_relevance: Consultations/screenings - ongoing child health surveillance, monitors pediatric care continuity in primary care.

indicators.name: Proporção de fumadores com consulta relacionada com tabaco no último ano
indicators.description: Proportion of smokers aged 14+ who received tobacco-related medical or nursing consultations within the past year.
indicators.pets_relevance: Screenings/consultations - tobacco cessation support coverage in primary care, relevant to preventive health monitoring.

indicators.name: Proporção de embalagens de medicamentos prescritos de classes terapêuticas com genérico
indicators.description: Proportion of medicine packages prescribed from therapeutic classes that have generic alternatives available.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care - prescription efficiency metric, tracks generic medicine adoption in NHS prescribing.

indicators.name: Proporção de visitas domiciliárias de enfermagem em fim-de-semana e feriado
indicators.description: Proportion of home nursing visits to ECCI users occurring on weekends or public holidays.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care - measures continuity of home care services including non-working days.

indicators.name: Proporção de utentes com contacto pela equipa multiprofissional nas primeiras 48h
indicators.description: Proportion of ECCI users who received contact from the multiprofessional team within the first 48 hours of admission.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care - measures responsiveness of integrated continuous care teams upon patient admission.

indicators.name: Número médio de visitas domiciliárias por utente por mês
indicators.description: Average number of home visits per user per month of integration in the ECCI.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care/consultations - intensity of home care delivery, relevant to monitoring community-based care.

indicators.name: Taxa anual ajustada de utilizadores muito frequentes do serviço de urgência hospitalar
indicators.description: Adjusted annual rate of frequent emergency department users per 100 primary care enrollees, standardized by age and gender.
indicators.pets_relevance: Urgencies - key indicator tracking frequent ED utilization, reflects gaps in primary care accessibility.

indicators.name: Proporção de consultas de doença aguda realizadas na unidade funcional de inscrição
indicators.description: Proportion of acute illness consultations performed at patients' registered functional units versus total same-day consultations plus emergency episodes.
indicators.pets_relevance: Urgencies/consultations - measures primary care capacity to absorb acute care demand, reducing emergency department pressure.

indicators.name: Proporção de diabéticos tipo 2 com HbA1c > 9% com insulina
indicators.description: Proportion of type 2 diabetes patients with HbA1c above 9% who are receiving insulin therapy.
indicators.pets_relevance: Screenings/consultations - diabetes management quality indicator, tracks treatment adequacy for poorly controlled patients.

indicators.name: Índice de acompanhamento adequado de úlceras de pressão
indicators.description: Quality of care coordination for pressure ulcer treatment across four dimensions: teamwork, continuity, outcomes, and efficiency.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care - care quality index for chronic wound management in community nursing.

indicators.name: Índice de acompanhamento adequado de úlceras venosas
indicators.description: Quality of care management for venous ulcer treatment across five dimensions: process adequacy, teamwork, continuity, results, and efficiency.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care - care quality index for venous ulcer management in community nursing.

indicators.name: Score dimensão 'segurança de utentes'
indicators.description: Evaluates implementation of continuous quality improvement processes focused on patient safety across eight assessment areas.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care - patient safety dimension score, relevant to overall healthcare quality monitoring.

indicators.name: Score dimensão 'outras atividades não assistenciais'
indicators.description: Evaluates team engagement in non-assistential activities unrelated to clinical governance, scored on a 0-2 scale.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care - non-clinical activity score, measures broader health unit engagement beyond direct patient care.

indicators.name: Score dimensão 'participação do cidadão'
indicators.description: Evaluates how functional units implement processes demonstrating concern for user needs and satisfaction.
indicators.pets_relevance: Primary health care - citizen participation dimension, tracks patient-centered care and satisfaction processes.

indicators.name: Proporção de comunidades educativas com mais conhecimentos em saúde oral
indicators.description: Proportion of educational communities that demonstrated improved knowledge about oral health following UCC interventions.
indicators.pets_relevance: Screenings - oral health literacy improvement through community health interventions in schools.

indicators.name: Proporção de utentes com vacina da gripe gratuita no SNS
indicators.description: Proportion of eligible users who received the free NHS flu vaccine during the autumn/winter period.
indicators.pets_relevance: Screenings/primary health care - flu vaccination coverage, key preventive health indicator for vulnerable populations.

indicators.name: Proporção de fumadores com abstinência tabágica 12 meses após dia D (CICT) - ACES
indicators.description: Proportion of smokers aged 15+ who maintain tobacco abstinence 12 months after quit date in intensive cessation programs (ACES level).
indicators.pets_relevance: Screenings/consultations - smoking cessation effectiveness at ACES level, tracks long-term health behavior change outcomes.

indicators.name: Proporção de fumadores com abstinência tabágica 12 meses após dia D (CICT) - UF
indicators.description: Proportion of smokers aged 15+ who maintain tobacco abstinence 12 months after quit date in intensive cessation programs (UF level).
indicators.pets_relevance: Screenings/consultations - smoking cessation effectiveness at functional unit level, measures local intervention impact.

indicators.name: Proporção de fumadores com CICT que foram medicados - ACES
indicators.description: Proportion of smokers aged 15+ with intensive smoking cessation support who received pharmacological therapy in the past year (ACES level).
indicators.pets_relevance: Screenings/consultations - pharmacological support coverage for smoking cessation at ACES level.

indicators.name: Proporção de fumadores com CICT que foram medicados - UF
indicators.description: Proportion of smokers aged 15+ enrolled in intensive tobacco cessation support who received pharmacological therapy within the past year (UF level).
indicators.pets_relevance: Screenings/consultations - pharmacological support coverage for smoking cessation at functional unit level.
